name: clock-tui (tclock)
summary: Rust terminal clock, timer, stopwatch and countdown. Big-digit clock with hex colors and a size multiplier; the one clock that runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. Binary is `tclock`.

install.notes: Needs a Rust toolchain: `winget install Rustlang.Rustup`. Not in winget or scoop; the repo documents cargo only. Built on crossterm and ratatui, so it should run in Windows Terminal, but no Windows run was seen.

windows.notes: The config path is built from the home folder (%USERPROFILE%\.config\tclock\config.toml), per src/config.rs.

install.notes: No Homebrew formula found. `brew install rustup` then `rustup default stable` gives the toolchain.
Arch: AUR only. No apt or dnf package found on Repology.

theme.notes: -c '#RRGGBB' or a named color; also default.color in config.toml.

config.notes: Size, seconds, date, timezone, mode (clock, timer, stopwatch, countdown).
